title: 专有名词识别：英语体育解说
content: Mane, Thiago, Luis Diaz. He's going to have a goal. It's deflected and it's in! Redemption, a route back for Liverpool from Luis Diaz with the help of a touch on the way through. And now it's time to believe again for those inside Anfield. And here comes another threat for Liverpool. Mohamed Salah's trying to get back. Round the corner goes Davis, and he's gone for goal and he's gone over the top. Simicass, one more burst. Naby Keita, Mohamed Salah. Still had a lot to do and the defender Sanchez got a touch.
